blocks.html: When it comes to skincare, laser body treatments accomplish several tasks, such as skin resurfacing and vein removal. Once requiring painful and risky surgery, skin rejuvenation can now be performed using less invasive, and equally as effective, laser techniques. At Victory Medical, the MedSpa specialists have extensive experience in erasing the effects of time on your skin.

Laser resurfacing is a treatment designed to erase the effects that time and the elements have had on your skin, including: Fine lines and wrinkles, Scarring, Hyperpigmentation. With laser resurfacing, a highly trained specialist at the Victory MedSpa passes a laser that emits short pulses of light over your target area to heat up and destroy old skin, layer by layer. This process also spurs the natural healing response in your skin, which increases collagen production.
We offer a variety of laser treatments for the skin at the Victory MedSpa, so have a look below, or schedule a consultation with our aestheticians to determine what treatment would work best for you.

A highly trained specialist at the Victory MedSpa will pass a painless laser that emits short pulses of light over your target area to heat up and destroy old skin, layer by layer. For example, if you wanted to get rid of some unwanted spider veins, laser treatments would break up these veins without destroying the surface of your skin. From there, your body would flush the debris through its lymphatic system, leaving clear skin behind.

If you have any questions or concenrs about how our laser treatments might affect your skin, call the Victory MedSpa today and we’ll be happy to assist you.

An BBL/IPL photofacial is a noninvasive laser therapy that uses intense pulsed light (IPL). The light travels below your skin without harming the surface area and removes targeted cells or pigmentation that is then naturally flushed out, leaving you with healthy cells and collagen that replace the damaged ones.
Spider veins are not a good look for anyone, but they are quite common among most skin types. With our laser vein removal treatment, we’ll have your skin cleared up from unwanted veins in no time!

If you’re not happy with the surface condition of your skin, our micro laser rejuvinating peel treatment might be good for you. The level of depth this treatment will resurface on your skin will be determined by your aesthetician, so book a consultation with the MedSpa today to find out what level would be good for you!
Take care of saggy areas with our SkinTyte treatment! This laser treatment is non-surgical and non-invasive to help you fix those troublesome areas.

Stop wasting time and money with all those razors and find a more semi permanent solution with our laser hair removal services! We are able to target a variety of areas, so book an appointment with the MedSpa to get rid of unwanted hair today!
